evidence_required: Interpretation of a ceiling fraction above 1.0 and of 0.1.

marking.criterion: Above 1.0 is physically impossible and means a data error, with at least two plausible causes (units, bidirectional counter, double count, wrong time)
0.1 means no throughput ceiling explains the time
Names what does dominate at 0.1 (latency, launch overhead, synchronization, queueing or stragglers)

title: Reading a ceiling fraction
